data.body: `end_time` is already computed via `ensure_end_after_start(info.start_time, info.end_time)` a few lines above (right after the `on_user_function_end` matching-start check) and used for the `_note_parent_end` calls. Neither `info.start_time` nor `info.end_time` change in between (the `info` dataclass is frozen), so this second call recomputes the exact same value. Harmless, but dead code that can confuse future edits (e.g., someone updating only one of the two call sites). Remove the redundant line and reuse the `end_time` already in scope.
